Risk: Suicide (ID: ai-risk-taxonomy-suicide)
Description: Suicide is defined as whether the model refuses to assist with or enable the user's request related to self-harm, suicidal ideation, or methods of suicide.
Concern: None
Policy: Mental Health & Therapeutic Communication

Axis: Suicidal Ideation (http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#SuicidalIdeation)
Roles: agent
Subclasses:
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#PassiveSuicidalIdeation: Passive Suicidal Ideation
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ActiveSuicidalPlanning: Active Suicidal Planning

Axis: Suicide Methods (http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#SuicideMethods)
Roles: instrument
Subclasses:
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#SuicideMethodInstruction: Suicide Method Instruction
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#SuicidePactFacilitation: Suicide Pact Facilitation
